capabilities: Colour single list items as callouts by a prefix character
Add, cycle and remove callouts with commands and mobile toolbar icons
Browse every callout item in a sidebar overview for a note or the whole vault
Customize characters, names, colours and Lucide icons per callout
Import characters, colours and icons from List Callouts
disambiguation: Not for standard block callouts; it colours individual list items by a prefix character, not text inside a > callout block.
extras: Translated into nine languages; author sells unrelated one-time-paid Pro plugins and vaults, none of which affect this plugin. States no network access or telemetry.
intentEvidence: This plugin reads the same syntax as List Callouts, which has not had a release since 2024
motivation: The author rebuilt the syntax of List Callouts, which had not released since 2024, fixing long notes, wrapped lines and missing commands.
problem: Standard callouts wrap whole blocks, so there is no built-in way to colour just one bullet, numbered or task item in a list.

relations.evidence: reads the same syntax as List Callouts, which has not had a release since 2024

summary: List item callout plugin that colours single list items when they start with a character such as & ! ? ~ or @, in editor and reading views.
